items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: And Leonard Feather mentions in his encyclopedia that you crossed the ocean 22 times, later went to the South Seas and Latin America.

ctx.x: I see. Okay. And Leonard Feather mentions in his encyclopedia that you crossed the ocean 22 times, later went to the South Seas and Latin America. Is that a good count?
Well, I don't know. I'm glad it's an even number, because I couldn't have gotten back where I was.
